about: Shared cases for Phase 3c (the breakeven rule, partial exits, stop moves) and the SQL. Inputs are invented; every "expected" was computed by the SQL named in each group (migrations 20261023000001..3 of fase-3c/banco), so the TypeScript test (cases3c.test.ts) checks that both sides give the same answer. Amounts are trimmed of trailing zeros (trim_scale) as the data layer reads them.

positions.about: import_stage(account, platform, 'UTC', rows) on a fresh account: row number → the app trade it links to. Positions in several rows (same symbol as written, side, open instant and open price, with an exit) link whole, or row by row when the app registered them as one trade per exit. Trades with eligible false are no candidates (a broker ID; origin null: no entry context). The Phase 3 scenarios of registro/cases.json were asked again of this import_stage: none changed.
